data.body: 549b change 2552 patchset 4: LLM-Review+1 PASS but CI Verified-1 — test_tests_import_convention.py (surfaced after Gerrit rebased onto newer main): held-out file used 'from tests.unit.test_fixture_selection import' which the bare pytest console script can't resolve. Fixed to bare sibling import 'from test_fixture_selection import finding, review' (matches established pattern) + ruff --fix import sort. Proactively ran 58 repo-wide guard tests (api-surface, error-handling, ruff/mypy ratchets, module-size, arg-sweep, both import-conventions) — all pass. 28 fixture+convention tests pass under bare pytest (CI invocation). Amended, pushed patchset 5. Awaiting re-vote.
